antiphonae_evangelicae.benedictus: Benedíctus Dóminus, qui ómnes pópulos redémit, et eos de ténebris in admirábile lumen suum vocávit.
antiphonae_evangelicae.magnificat: Magnificémus Dóminum, qui húmilem servum suum Martínum donis cæléstibus exaltávit.
antiphonae_evangelicae.benedictus_es: Bendito sea el Señor, porque ha redimido a todos los pueblos, y los ha llamado a salir de la tiniebla y a entrar en su luz maravillosa.
antiphonae_evangelicae.magnificat_es: Proclamemos la grandeza del Señor, que ha enaltecido con dones celestiales a su humilde siervo Martín.

collecta: Deus, qui beatum Martinum per humilitatis iter ad cælestem gloriam perduxisti, tribue nobis eius ita nunc persequi exempla præclara, ut exaltari cum ipso mereamur in cælis. Per Dominum.
source_note: Magnificat/Benedictus antiphons were previously the wrong shared COMMON_HOLY_MEN_WOMEN placeholder text. Replaced with text for Martin de Porres's own office, sourced in Spanish from eltestigofiel.org; Latin is a direct faithful translation. The Magnificat antiphon explicitly names Martín and is clearly proper; the Benedictus antiphon is more generic in theme and may itself be a Común text, flagged for a possible future second look. Collect was already correct, unchanged.
